determination_rule: An anchor requires the site-statistics arm iff its audit record's evidence vocabulary (evidence_tests, or any support line's tests in evidence_independence) names distribution or functional_role — the properties the defective validation measured and the site-statistics lineage measures. An anchor requires the phonotactic arm iff that vocabulary names phonetic_value, or its R5 rule text rests the defect on a check of the reading's sound shape. An anchor engaging neither arm is undeterminable and is recorded as phonotactic-gated (the conservative direction, per plan.md Stage 1).

arm_definitions.site_statistics_arm: The repair brief's corrected site-statistics lineage, site_stats_v2 (backend/glossa_lab/site_stats_v2.py): distributional measurement done properly — a computed statistic and p-value, explicit insufficient-data outcomes, no invented values, no equivalence verdicts.
arm_definitions.phonotactic_arm: The repair brief's corrected phonotactic checker, phonotactics_v2 (backend/glossa_lab/phonotactics_v2.py): the reading's initial sound against declared rules. Its rule set is not linguist-certified (GR-088-04), so the arm is dependency-gated wherever it is required (C091-11): no phonotactic verdict is produced under the uncertified rule set.
